info.name: Monoova PayTo Reporting API
info.description:
# Introduction

The Monoova PayTo API is designed to efficiently handle real time financial transactions, providing a reliable platform for creating payment agreements and initiating payments.

Contact Support:
 Name: Monoova Support
 Email: support@monoova.com

item.name: Get Payment Agreements by Date Range

query.description: (Required) Start Date. </br>Required. ISO8601 date-time

Page to be returned after records are split as per pageSize.
Optional, If not provided, it is defaulted to 1.
Number of records per page. </br> Optional, If not provided page size will be defaulted to 50. Maximum allowed value is 200.
End Date. Optional, if not provided it will be defaulted to createdStartDate +24 hours. ISO8601 date-time
